findings.text: Non-blocking. is_eligible catches only TrackerRoutingError from resolve_repo. A structurally malformed config passed straight to is_eligible (e.g. mechanism 'label' with no 'label_prefix') could make _routing_candidates raise KeyError, which would propagate rather than fail closed. This is out of contract: config always arrives from load_tracker_config, which _validate rejects such a shape on load (AC1), and resolve_repo shares the same validated-config precondition. Under the documented contract (a loaded, validated config) is_eligible never raises. Recorded only as an adversarial edge; the shipped path is clean. A future hardening could catch (TrackerRoutingError, TrackerConfigError, KeyError, TypeError) at the resolve_repo call so is_eligible is total even on an unvalidated config.
